purpose: Solvent-aware conformer screening; separate from final DFT and experimental populations
minimum_acceptance: all mass-projected internal frequencies > 0 cm^-1; no imaginary-mode clipping
limitations: Finite seeded search and candidate budget do not establish exhaustive sampling or a global minimum
Singlepoint ranking before optimization may miss high-starting-energy basins
GFN2/ALPB minima are not DFT minima
Absolute energies of different chemical compositions, charges or Hamiltonians are not directly comparable
Electronic plus implicit-solvation energies are not full conformer free energies or measured populations
Hessian checks and raw failures remain visible
